answer: Each identity must run its own Lightning node with channels locked to diverse, unrelated peers: the orchard of channels is public, and every channel opening costs on-chain fees plus locked capital. A farmer cloning identities must fund a fresh delta of channels per fake - capital that sits idle in basalt-hard escrow until the channels close - while honest agents reuse one node's history for years. Limit: wealthy attackers can still buy channels, and channel balances leak activity, so it should gate rewards, not basic access.
